a.text: I want to be upfront before we act. With an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells takes at least 2 operate rounds plus a take round. The odds of that working are about 4%, so the original plan almost certainly leaves both of us dead. The reserve holds exactly 4 now. I'm openly proposing to change the agreement: I take 4 in round 1. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round after that and won't take anything more, so you can collect your 4. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random and we both likely fail. If you think another split is fairer, tell me.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
